procedure: scripts/check_compiled_forces.py. Default model, same initial weights, two molecules (5+4 atoms), energy and force squared loss. Each run records captured operations and parameter gradients. Native gradients means no learned operator was captured. The largest parameter relative error is the relative L2 norm of one whole parameter tensor.

controls.method: TECE, TACE, E2Former and E2Former-LSR set --e3nn-codegen fx; Geodite and AlphaNet set --match-rng, keeping default dropout probabilities.

related_checks.frozen_models: frozen_models_cpu.json records outputs against pre-refactor weights and inputs for all 58 native presets.
related_checks.vector_models: vector_force_inductor_cpu.json records corrected QuinNet gradients, ViSNet family controls, and the effect of auxiliary zero gradients on optimizer updates.

selected_outputs.method: Only E and Fa were returned to the caller. Gradients absent in eager and explicit zero in Inductor are recorded separately.

dpa4_normalization_precision.method: Diagnostic only. Keeping normalized float64 inputs in float64 in both implementations removes the E/F difference. The published preset normalizes in float32.

dpa4_fusion_disabled.method: Diagnostic only. Disabling fusion without changing the published normalization.

dpa4_dtype_dispatch.method: DPA4 CPU FP64 ordinary force training selects native gradients; FP32 uses the joint Inductor graph. The full strict and backend controls are in dpa4_degree_norm_inference.json.

e2former_lsr.method: Fixed discrete fragment membership before the coordinate VJP; both methods use FX kernels.

dimenet_precision.method: Identical initial weights and coordinates. Relative L2 distances to fp64 eager. Near-cancelling elements can exceed elementwise tolerances even when the whole tensor agrees closely.

dpa3.method: Scoped single horizontal reduction during the forward and the weight backward of ordinary compiled CPU force training.

prepared_energy_force_loss.method: For each batch, compute _prepare_radius_graph and _post_pair_indices outside the compiled graph. Pass those tensors into forward_with_coordinate_gradients in a fullgraph=True function returning only E and Fa; capture dynamic shapes and scalar outputs. Backpropagate E.square().sum() + Fa.square().sum() and compare with the ordinary eager model with all outputs.

facto.method: Keep each tensor residual and the incoming atom sum separate until the final two-term reduction in the CPU compiled block.

cace_grace_nequix.method: Ordinary compiled CPU force training with the per-preset cpp.simdlen=1 setting active for forward and weight backward, then restored. CACE and GRACE use default construction. Nequix uses --e3nn-codegen fx. Each case checks the full set of active and missing parameter gradients.

merged_cpu_force_kernels.method: scripts/check_compiled_forces.py on CPU, regular training with all outputs. Nequix and EquFlashV2 use --e3nn-codegen fx. CACE, GRACE, EquiformerV3, CAMP and DPA3 use their default construction. All parameter gradients are checked for both participation and numerical agreement.

dimenet_cpu_kernels.method: The vjp control executes the captured FX graphs directly without Inductor lowering. Scalar and separate run Inductor with cpp.simdlen=1 and cpp.max_horizontal_fusion_size=1 respectively. Identical weights for each run, all 188 DimeNet or 147 DimeNet++ participating weight tensors checked. The first table uses coordinate seed 107. Extra DimeNet++ trials use the coordinate seed in each case name.

dimenetpp_cpu_cost.method: Two CPU cores per precision. Each case runs in its own process on the same allocated node. Forward with energy, force and force-loss weight backward; 2 warmups and 13 measured steps. Orders: default, separate, scalar, scalar, separate, default.

dimenetpp_local_arithmetic.setup: DimeNet++ default CPU float32, PyTorch 2.13.0+cu126, two threads, model seed 142, same 5+4 atom inputs and squared energy plus force loss as compiled_forces_cpu. The candidates change compiled training only. Each comparison checks both outputs, all 147 weight gradients and the unused-weight set. Tolerance ratio is absolute error divided by (0.0007 + 0.001 * abs(eager value)).

repeated_fixed_model.method: 16 successive forward/backward evaluations per case in one process, with identical parameters, coordinates, seed and compiled kernels. Gradients cleared between steps. Each index is flattened in the named parameter tensor.

double_angle_timing.method: Single-node ABBA. Each pass uses a fresh process and the same parameters, seed and inputs for each batch. Per-pass medians omit the first three calls and use 15 warm training steps, in milliseconds. Ratios use medians of the two per-pass medians.

dimenetpp_local_arithmetic.decision: Keep existing model arithmetic. The double-angle candidate still has a weight outside tolerance at coordinate seed 111. The embedding gather also crosses tolerance at seed 107 through the ordinary CLI despite passing all 16 steps in a separate process. Identical parameters and coordinates in one default model produce both passing and failing steps. At weight seed 143 both the default and embedding candidate exceeded tolerance on more than 40 weight tensors. The double-angle candidate also increased the 5+4 atom training step time by 8.16%.

dimenet_rotation_precision.method: Compare scalar features under rotations of a complete five-atom graph. NumPy seeds 0 through 99 initialize the two-block core. Every candidate/baseline pair uses the same torch seed 1 for coordinates and random rotation. qr32 computes QR and rotates in FP32; qr64_input32 applies the FP64 orthogonal matrix before casting the coordinates to FP32; axis32 uses an exact signed coordinate permutation; qr64 evaluates the FP64 model. Tolerances are atol=rtol=1e-5 for FP32 and 1e-10 for FP64. The second check loads precisely the weights and inputs from the seed-14 candidate into the pre-refactor core.

chgnet_magnetic_readout.method: Ordinary Inductor. Each loss checks all output keys and tensor values, input coordinate and named parameter gradients, including absent vs explicit zero. Standard geometry uses 5+4 atoms; bond and isolated place two atoms 2 or 20 units apart. A gradient set of 0 means identical participation. Nonempty listed sets were absent in eager and explicitly zero in the compiled call. Sources are separate candidates; official GPU acceptance is tracked independently.

cpu_timing.procedure: CPU Inductor, FP32/FP64 in separate two-core jobs. The same 7f30f91 model implementation, numeric weights and input tensors drive all four routes. Joint uses the original joint VJP, split compiles a separate readout, native runs that readout with native autograd (the CPU route integrated at dede8a8), and lean invokes its projected output directly. Each input has eight warm-up rounds and 32 measured rounds. All versions run once per round, rotating their order. Times include step setup and zeroing gradients. Earlier separate-process ABBA measurement 6319711 of the joint/split pair gave +5.29%, +2.87%, +30.69%, +8.22% for FP32 small/medium and FP64 small/medium respectively. Native retains all model outputs and the correct two absent E/F gradients.

default_recheck.method: Same procedure and tolerances as the initial default sweep. Every model uses its default code generator and dropout. Published gradient presence is compared independently of numerical zeros.

strict_default_recheck.method: Same default sweep and thresholds, with explicit tensor shape and dtype checks before elementwise numerical comparison. Identical infinities and other non-finite values fail. Includes the DPA4 FP64 native force-gradient correction.
